headline: Aromatase inhibitors
body: *Letrozole* and *anastrozole* block testosterone converting into estrogen. | Less estrogen means slower bone maturation. | In boys that means more adult height.
punch: The mechanism is sound. The evidence is thinner than you think.

headline: The entire evidence base
body: is **four** randomised trials. **207** participants total. | 84 actually on the drug. | That is everything, in male children and adolescents with short stature.
punch: Four trials. That is the whole randomised record.

headline: All four improved
body: *predicted* adult height. | Predicted adult height is a **model output**. It is a forecast, not a person. | Only one trial followed anyone to actual near final height.
punch: Three of the four never checked whether it worked.

headline: And that one trial
body: found **no meaningful difference**. | The single time anyone measured the outcome that matters, the effect did not appear. | And that was under non randomised extension conditions.
punch: Predicted height went up. Real height did not.

headline: Now the safety side
body: The same drugs are standard therapy in postmenopausal breast cancer, often for years. | That population has been studied hard for adverse effects. | So we know exactly what to look for.
punch: And nobody looked for it in the height studies.

headline: What shows up
body: in the oncology population. | Joint and muscle pain. Altered retinal function. | Subtle hits to verbal and visual memory.
punch: Your brain makes its own estrogen and these drugs block that too.

headline: The brain
body: is an *aromatase expressing organ*. | It produces estrogen locally, independent of your gonads. | Blocking the enzyme systemically blocks it there too.
punch: The brain is not collateral. It is a target.

headline: Now the actual gap
body: Paediatric height studies generally do not screen for sensory or cognitive outcomes. | One major cohort ran a **median 25 months** of treatment. | With **zero** cognitive endpoints recorded.
punch: No reported harm is not evidence of no harm.

headline: And when someone did look
body: 24 adolescent males, 12 months of letrozole. | Bone age progression fell from **1.51 to 0.68**. Predicted height improved nearly a full standard deviation. | Then they tested adrenal function.
punch: Roughly **one in four** showed subnormal ACTH response.

headline: The authors concluded
body: mild **adrenal suppression**. | Aromatase inhibition is not organ selective. The adrenal participates in steroid synthesis too. | You cannot inhibit an enzyme in only one place.

headline: Which is the pattern
body: The efficacy half of that paper gets quoted constantly. | The safety half does not. | A paper reporting its own inconvenient finding is the kind worth trusting.
punch: Look and you find. That is the whole argument.

headline: It's never over
body: Real mechanisms. Real citations. No protocols.
